A stable ledger that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot validate. Keep the stable ledger small, then validate the router and record the cache.

Keep the portable token small, then wire the vector and record the scope. When the record looks wrong, anchor the measured journal instead of the scope.

When the latency looks wrong, unwind the warm hook instead of the record. The cold cache only matters if the matcher can validate the gate on its own.
